comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district signs. lat/lon are real OSM coordinates projected the same way as landmarks.json. radius = trigger distance in compressed-world meters. needs_owner_review entries need the owner's lived knowledge to verify placement — map data is approximate for these.

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Where the Palisadoes road meets Kingston. Potholes begin here.

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Historic former capital of Jamaica. Founded by the Spanish in 1534.

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Village at the entrance to Bog Walk Gorge, through which the Rio Cobre flows.

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Market town in St Catherine, famous for the folk song 'Linstead Market'.

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Small St Ann town near a natural lake, gateway to Ocho Rios.

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Three-kilometre ravine road canopied by tree ferns — a natural wonder.
